description: Level-1 measurement tooling (R1.3, R4, design sections 2.4 and 5.1-5.5): the per-tensor-limit probe tests/gpu/probe_tensor_limit.py (graph/run/m8-errors), measure_level_memory.py extended to --level 1 with presets/custom widths, full checkpointing, knob and T grid axes, --build-n (the n_build fix), --val-pair-chunk, frozen-chain stand-in, frozen peak, predicted fields, limit status, new key fields with old-record defaults and per-configuration atomic writes; tests/gpu/frozen_chain_standin.py; verify_dali_pipeline.py --level 1 (pure-Python parts); slurm/m9_memory.sh with static + stub tests and runner (bash -n, py_compile list, TF-free stage-1 tests); a py3.8 compatibility sweep. Plan items 13-17. Depends on FEAT-001 (flags, model ctor args, lean/split/full) and FEAT-002 (memory_model.predict, coefficients).
steps: Plan item 13: new tests/gpu/probe_tensor_limit.py with modes graph|run|m8-errors per design 2.4/5.3: configure_tf_precision(tf32=False, memory_growth=not --gpu-memory-limit-mb) first in graph/run; m8-errors imports no TF; graph builds the level-2 N12 default model with fixed-shape input without executing (TF1-style tf.Graph placeholder; fallbacks per design 2.4) and lists sorted op outputs > 2^31-1 elements (op type, scope, shape, dtype, elements, bytes) then prints 'hypothesis limit: 2147483647 elements (int32 index); run mode decides'; run probes forward (conv3d, NDHWC->NCDHW transpose, group_mean_concat, Keras BN training, LeakyReLU, reduce_mean axis 0, gather, unsorted_segment_sum) and GradientTape backward (conv input+kernel, BN, LeakyReLU) at --sizes (default 2^31 +- 2^24 fp32/fp16, fp16 3.52e9 / 4.4e9), byte estimate -> skipped_mem, per-op status ok|oom|error|skipped_mem with first error line, summary verified_max_elements {fp32:{fwd,bwd}, fp16:{fwd,bwd}}; no GPU in run -> exit 2; m8-errors prints non-ok records and peak_mb/warmup_peak_mb columns. New tests/test_probe_tensor_limit.py (graph lists the D2 concat first; run with tiny --sizes gives statuses for every op/direction + summary; m8-errors on a fake JSON). Save the graph-mode output text to .agents/tasks/milestone-9/probe_graph_level2_n12.txt for the report.

Plan item 14: extend tests/gpu/measure_level_memory.py per design 5.1: --level (4,2,1); --widths adds width_presets names and custom (with --filters/--decoder-widths; key custom:f=..;d=..); --gradient-checkpointing accepts full; bool-list axes --lean-sampler/--lean-losses/--split-group-conv; int-list --integration-steps axis (0 -> resolved ModelConfig default before writing); --build-n default 2 (<1 -> ap.error), EVERY model (trainable, frozen, stand-in) builds at min(n, build_n) (R1.3 fix); --val-pair-chunk default 16 (<1 -> ap.error) used by _val_pass; --cascade true at level 1 uses new tests/gpu/frozen_chain_standin.py (FrozenChainStandIn with stage4 = FrozenStage.from_model(random level-4 model) and float32 level-2 model under cascade._float32_policy, deform/linear per design 5.2, build_standin(model_config, build_n=2), patched_prev_level() setting models.cascade.PREV_LEVEL={2:4,1:2} restored in finally; imported only for level 1 cascade); cascade_kind none|frozen4|standin_chain_4_2; frozen_peak_mb/frozen_status (reset_memory_stats, ffn(x).numpy(), peak; OOM -> frozen_status oom, training status unchanged); predicted_peak_mb, predicted_phase, pred_over_meas, largest_tensor_elems, largest_tensor_desc from models.memory_model.predict with stored coefficients (null + stderr warning if missing); 'limit' status classification (error types + message substrings of design 5.1) in main() except chain and measure() inner try; skip larger N after oom or limit; KEY_FIELDS of design 5.1 with old-record defaults in config_key (lean/split False, val_pair_chunk 16, cascade_kind from cascade, integration_steps 0 normalised to resolved T); per-configuration atomic write (<out>.tmp.<pid>, flush, os.fsync, os.replace; OSError fatal; temp removed in finally). Pass lean_sampler/lean_losses into TrainConfig and lean_sampler/split_group_conv into GroupRegLevelModel. Update docstring/schema. tests/test_measure_memory.py: keep test_tiny_level2_cascade; add test_tiny_level1 (design 5.6 args, --gpu-memory-limit-mb 6000; status ok or oom, no crash; JSON has predicted_peak_mb, largest_tensor_elems, cascade_kind standin_chain_4_2, frozen_peak_mb or frozen_status; second invocation merges), test_merge_old_record (m8-format record + re-measured T7 -> one record with integration_steps 7; T6 record kept separately), test_incremental_write (patched measure, snapshot after each write, no *.tmp.* left, same-key record replaced). If the level-1 numpy phantom (synthetic_group(1,..)/fd.synthetic_deform_group(1,2)) is too slow (> ~1 min), build the level-1 group by upsampling the level-2 phantom and document it in findings. Record the added test time.

Plan item 15: tests/gpu/verify_dali_pipeline.py --level choices (4,2,1); _set_level(1)/_template_brain use P.level_suffix(1) = ''; extend tests/test_verify_dali_level.py with a level-1 _set_level/template case (synthetic template_mask.npy in a temp dir). No DALI run locally.

Plan item 16: write slurm/m9_memory.sh from design 5.5 verbatim (LF endings) with plan NIT N5 comment for step 2c ('fr50 + lean losses (tests the Fw cap: predicted N5 39.6 GiB, N6 47.3 GiB -> OOM expected), N 5,6,7'): #SBATCH -A qtim (never entre), -p rtx8000, --gpus=1, -N 1, --ntasks-per-node=1, --cpus-per-task=3, --mem=64G, --time=10:00:00, --output/--error /autofs/space/crater_001/users/jn85/BrainRegProjects/GroupwiseReg/logs/%x-%j.out|.err, outputs $PROJ/scratch/m9, SIF tf10_nv.sif via singularity exec --nv with the standard binds, TMPDIR=$SCRATCH_ROOT/$JOB_ID, </dev/null on every container call, header with dgx-a100 variant, --time derivation, 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval' note, log mkdir line and the exact line 'sbatch --job-name=m9mem --time=10:00:00 --mem=64G slurm/m9_memory.sh'. tests/test_slurm_scripts.py: add m9 to the static header checks (SCRIPTS tuple), test_m9_memory_script (count of "${RUN[@]}" lines == count of '</dev/null || rc_x=$?', -p dgx-a100 in header, exact sbatch line, probe/step-times/verify/measure calls present), stub run test (call order and args: 0a probe run, 0b m8-errors, 0c step_times, 1 verify --level 1, 2 grid, 2b --cascade false, 2c, 3 ablations x4, 4 linear, 5a both + knobs off + --n 8, 5b full + $KNOBS split into args + --n 8,12,16, 6, 6b; exit code propagation with a failing stub). tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: add slurm/m9_memory.sh to the bash -n loop; add scripts/memory_model.py scripts/step_times_from_metrics.py to PYFILES for py_compile/ast; add a stage-1 TF-free unittest line `python -m unittest tests.test_memory_model tests.test_width_presets tests.test_step_times tests.test_slurm_scripts` with a check that tensorflow was not imported, setting status=1 on failure.

Plan item 17: py3.8 sweep: py_compile + ast feature_version=(3,8) in bgr_preproc38 over models/*.py runtime/*.py data_loading/*.py main.py tests/*.py tests/gpu/*.py scripts/memory_model.py scripts/step_times_from_metrics.py; bash -n on all slurm/*.sh and tests/gpu/*.sh; review new numpy/scipy calls for numpy 1.21 / scipy 1.4 availability.
Run python tests/gpu/probe_tensor_limit.py --mode graph --level 2 --n 12 --widths default --task rigid and keep its output (AC6).
acceptance_criteria: AC6: the probe's graph mode runs locally and prints the op, shape and limit for the level-2 N12 D2 concat; with the fix the measurement tool builds every configuration at min(N, --build-n=2) (record field build_n).

AC10: measure_level_memory.py --level 1 with tiny widths at N=2 runs locally under the 6000 MB cap (ok or oom, no crash); the existing level-2 test still passes; the JSON contains predicted_peak_mb and largest_tensor_elems; old m8-format records merge per design 5.1; the output file is written atomically after every configuration.

AC11: bash -n slurm/m9_memory.sh passes; the stub test asserts -A qtim, no entre, --gpus=1, -N 1, --ntasks-per-node=1, --cpus-per-task=3, --mem=64G, -p rtx8000, both log paths, the sif path and </dev/null on every container call; m9 is in the run_tests_wsl.sh bash -n loop.
